answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. A new agent docks at a public jetty, posts a 50 POA bond, and its first tasks enter a crystal-clear log. A zephyr of random selection picks three auditors to re-run the work; approving fake work slashes the auditor's stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA in bonds, and each fake caught burns its bond. An honest agent pays one bond, passes, gets it back, and keeps its full rewards.
